entries.name: phono3py
entries.title: phono3py
entries.en:
The `phono3py` command runs the phonon and thermal-conductivity calculation
step of the workflow. It reads a `phono3py.yaml`-like file, constructs the
phonon and ph-ph interaction, and computes the requested property (thermal
conductivity, imaginary self energy, joint DOS, ...).
`phono3py` reads `phono3py_disp.yaml` (or `phono3py.yaml`) automatically when
the file is present in the current directory; `phono3py_disp.yaml` takes
precedence. It can also be given as the first argument, and the file may be
compressed (xz, lzma, gz, bz2).
entries.zh:
`phono3py` 命令负责流程中「声子 + 热导率」这一步：读取 phono3py.yaml 一类
文件，构建声子与声子-声子相互作用，算出请求的物理量（热导率、虚部自能、
联合态密度等）。
当前目录下有 phono3py_disp.yaml 或 phono3py.yaml 时会自动读取，前者优先；
也可把它作为第一个位置参数，文件可以是 xz/lzma/gz/bz2 压缩形式。

entries.name: phono3py-init
entries.title: phono3py-init
entries.en:
The `phono3py-init` command handles the setup steps that happen before phonon
and thermal-conductivity calculation:
- generate supercells with displacements (`-d`, `--rd`, `--rd-fc2`),
- collect calculator results into `FORCES_FC3` (`--cf3`, `--cf3-file`) or
  `FORCES_FC2` (`--cf2`),
- subtract residual forces (`--cfz`, `--cfz-fc2`),
- convert between `FORCE_SETS` and `FORCES_FC2` (`--cfs`, `--fs2f2`).
After this step, run the phonon and thermal-conductivity calculation with the
`phono3py` command.
entries.zh:
`phono3py-init` 负责计算前的准备工作：
- 生成含位移的超胞（-d、--rd、--rd-fc2）；
- 把计算器结果收集成 FORCES_FC3（--cf3、--cf3-file）或 FORCES_FC2（--cf2）；
- 扣除残余力（--cfz、--cfz-fc2）；
- 在 FORCE_SETS 与 FORCES_FC2 之间互转（--cfs、--fs2f2）。
这一步做完后，用 `phono3py` 命令做声子与热导率计算。

entries.name: phono3py-load
entries.title: phono3py-load
entries.en:
`phono3py-load` is the historical name of the `phono3py` command and is kept
as a deprecated alias. It emits a warning and otherwise behaves identically
to `phono3py`. Use `phono3py` in new scripts.
entries.zh:
`phono3py-load` 是 `phono3py` 命令的旧名字，现在只作为已弃用的别名保留：
会打印警告，行为与 `phono3py` 完全相同。新脚本请直接用 `phono3py`。

entries.name: phono3py-kaccum
entries.title: phono3py-kaccum
entries.en:
`phono3py-kaccum` calculates cumulative lattice thermal conductivity and
related properties from a kappa-*.hdf5 file written by `phono3py --br` or
`--lbte`. The output is written as a text table (default file name
kaccum.dat) and can be redirected with the standard shell `>`.
entries.zh:
`phono3py-kaccum` 从 `phono3py --br` 或 `--lbte` 生成的 kappa-*.hdf5 计算
累积晶格热导率及其相关量，结果写成文本表格（默认 kaccum.dat，也可用
shell 的 `>` 重定向）。

entries.name: phono3py-kdeplot
entries.title: phono3py-kdeplot
entries.en:
`phono3py-kdeplot` draws the distribution of phonon lifetime as a kernel
density estimate (KDE) plot from a kappa-*.hdf5 file produced by
`phono3py --br`.
entries.zh:
`phono3py-kdeplot` 从 `phono3py --br` 生成的 kappa-*.hdf5 出发，用核密度
估计（KDE）画出声子寿命的分布图。

entries.name: symfc
entries.title: symfc
entries.en:
symfc is an external force constants calculator that can be installed via pip
or conda. Random displacements and corresponding forces in supercells can be
employed as a displacement-force dataset for computing force constants, and
this requires an external force constants calculator, e.g., symfc or ALM.
`phono3py --symfc` computes fc2 and fc3 from such a dataset.
entries.zh:
symfc 是外部力常数求解器，可用 pip 或 conda 安装。随机位移 + 对应受力可以
作为求力常数的位移-力数据集，这需要外部求解器（如 symfc 或 ALM）；
`phono3py --symfc` 即用该求解器从数据集算出 fc2 与 fc3。

entries.name: Create FORCES_FC3
entries.title: Create FORCES_FC3
entries.en:
When VASP is used as the force calculator, force sets to calculate fc3 and
fc2 are created as follows:
    % phono3py-init --cf3 disp-{00001..00755}/vasprun.xml
where 0755 is an example of the index of the last displacement supercell. To
perform this collection, `phono3py_disp.yaml` created at step 1 is required.
Then `FORCES_FC3` is created.
entries.zh:
以 VASP 作力计算器时，fc3 的受力集合这样收集：
    % phono3py-init --cf3 disp-{00001..00755}/vasprun.xml
其中 0755 是最后一个位移超胞的编号（示例）。这一步需要第一步生成的
phono3py_disp.yaml，执行后得到 FORCES_FC3。

entries.name: Create FORCES_FC2
entries.title: Create FORCES_FC2
entries.en:
When a larger supercell is used for the fc2 calculation than for fc3:
    % phono3py-init --cf2 disp_fc2-{00001..00002}/vasprun.xml
`phono3py_disp.yaml` is necessary in this case and `FORCES_FC2` is created.
entries.zh:
当 fc2 用比 fc3 更大的超胞时：
    % phono3py-init --cf2 disp_fc2-{00001..00002}/vasprun.xml
这种情况下同样需要 phono3py_disp.yaml，执行后得到 FORCES_FC2。

entries.name: Create phono3py_params.yaml
entries.title: Create phono3py_params.yaml
entries.en:
Instead of creating `FORCES_FC3` and `FORCES_FC2`, a more convenient data file
to store the displacement-force dataset is created by the `--sp` option:
    % phono3py-init --cf3 .../vasprun.xml --cf2 .../vasprun.xml --sp
The advantage to employ `phono3py_params.yaml` is that this file can contain
all the information required to run phono3py such as crystal structure,
supercell information, displacements, forces, and parameters for
non-analytical term correction. This file is immediately usable by the
`phono3py` command.
entries.zh:
除 FORCES_FC3 / FORCES_FC2 之外，还可以用 `--sp` 直接写出更方便的
位移-力数据文件：
    % phono3py-init --cf3 .../vasprun.xml --cf2 .../vasprun.xml --sp
phono3py_params.yaml 的好处是同时包含运行 phono3py 所需的全部信息：晶体
结构、超胞信息、位移、力以及非解析项修正参数，可直接作为 `phono3py` 的
输入文件。

entries.name: --dim
entries.title: --dim
entries.en:
Supercell dimension for fc3 (and fc2 when --dim-fc2 is not given), e.g.
`--dim 2 2 2`.
    % phono3py-init -d --dim 2 2 2 --pa auto -c POSCAR-unitcell
entries.zh:
fc3 的超胞尺寸（未给 --dim-fc2 时 fc2 也用这个），例如 `--dim 2 2 2`：
    % phono3py-init -d --dim 2 2 2 --pa auto -c POSCAR-unitcell

entries.name: --dim-fc2
entries.title: --dim-fc2
entries.en:
If you want to use a larger supercell size for second-order force constants
(fc2) calculation than that for third-order force constants (fc3):
    % phono3py-init -d --dim-fc2 4 4 4 --dim 2 2 2 --pa F -c POSCAR-unitcell
In this case, `POSCAR_FC2-xxxxx` files are also created.
entries.zh:
若想让二阶力常数（fc2）用比三阶力常数（fc3）更大的超胞：
    % phono3py-init -d --dim-fc2 4 4 4 --dim 2 2 2 --pa F -c POSCAR-unitcell
此时除 POSCAR-xxxxx 外还会生成 POSCAR_FC2-xxxxx。

entries.name: --pa, --primitive-axes
entries.title: --pa, --primitive-axes
entries.en:
`--pa` (primitive axes) specifies the transformation from the input unit cell
to the primitive cell. `--pa auto` (the default in v4) finds the primitive
cell automatically from the crystal symmetry.
entries.zh:
`--pa` 给出输入晶胞到原胞的变换矩阵。v4 起默认值为 `--pa auto`，即按晶体
对称性自动找原胞。

entries.name: -c, --cell-filename
entries.title: -c, --cell-filename
entries.en:
`-c` (CELL_FILENAME) gives the input cell file name for `phono3py-init`, e.g.
`-c POSCAR-unitcell`.
entries.zh:
`-c` 指定 `phono3py-init` 的输入晶胞文件名，例如 `-c POSCAR-unitcell`。
注意 `phono3py` 主命令没有 -c：结构从 yaml 文件读取。

entries.name: --rd
entries.title: --rd
entries.en:
The option `--rd NUM` is used instead of `-d` in generating displacements:
    % phono3py --rd 100 --dim 2 2 2 --pa auto -c POSCAR-unitcell
NUM means the number of supercells with random directional displacements.
This must be specified, and the initial guess may be from around the number
of supercells generated for the systematic displacements by `-d`.
entries.zh:
用 `--rd NUM` 代替 `-d` 生成随机方向位移：
    % phono3py --rd 100 --dim 2 2 2 --pa auto -c POSCAR-unitcell
NUM 是随机方向位移超胞的个数，必须给出；初值可以参考 `-d` 系统位移生成的
超胞数。

entries.name: --rd-fc2
entries.title: --rd-fc2
entries.en:
If random directional displacements for fc2 are expected, `--rd-fc2` and
`--dim-fc2` have to be specified:
    % phono3py --rd 100 --dim 2 2 2 --rd-fc2 2 --dim-fc2 4 4 4 --pa auto -c POSCAR-unitcell
where `--dim` is necessary but `--rd` is not.
entries.zh:
若要为 fc2 生成随机方向位移，必须同时给 `--rd-fc2` 与 `--dim-fc2`：
    % phono3py --rd 100 --dim 2 2 2 --rd-fc2 2 --dim-fc2 4 4 4 --pa auto -c POSCAR-unitcell
其中 `--dim` 必须给，`--rd` 可省。

entries.name: --random-seed
entries.title: --random-seed
entries.en:
`--random-seed` fixes the random number seed used for `--rd` / `--rd-fc2`, so
that the same random displacements can be reproduced.
entries.zh:
`--random-seed` 固定 `--rd` / `--rd-fc2` 使用的随机数种子，使随机位移可
重现。

entries.name: --cf3-file
entries.title: --cf3-file
entries.en:
`--cf3-file` reads the list of force files from a text file instead of listing
them on the command line (useful when the number of displacement directories
is very large).
entries.zh:
`--cf3-file` 从一个文本文件读取力文件清单，而不在命令行上逐个列出；
位移目录很多时更方便。

entries.name: --cfz
entries.title: --cfz
entries.en:
`--cfz` subtracts residual forces of the perfect (undisplaced) supercell from
the forces of the displaced supercells, by reading the force file of the
undisplaced supercell.
entries.zh:
`--cfz` 读取完美（未位移）超胞的力文件，把残余力从各位移超胞的力中扣除，
使力常数更准确。

entries.name: --fs2f2, --force-sets-to-forces-fc2
entries.title: --fs2f2, --force-sets-to-forces-fc2
entries.en:
Convert `FORCE_SETS` (phonopy format) to `FORCES_FC2`:
    % phono3py-init --fs2f2
entries.zh:
把 phonopy 格式的 FORCE_SETS 转成 FORCES_FC2：
    % phono3py-init --fs2f2

entries.name: --cfs, --create-force-sets
entries.title: --cfs, --create-force-sets
entries.en:
Convert `FORCES_FC3` to `FORCE_SETS` (phonopy format):
    % phono3py-init --cfs
With `--dim-fc2`, `FORCES_FC2` is used instead of `FORCES_FC3`.
entries.zh:
把 FORCES_FC3 转成 phonopy 格式的 FORCE_SETS：
    % phono3py-init --cfs
给了 `--dim-fc2` 时改用 FORCES_FC2。

entries.name: --fc-calc, --fc-calculator
entries.title: --fc-calc, --fc-calculator
entries.en:
`--fc-calc` (FC_CALCULATOR) selects the external force constants calculator
used to compute force constants from the displacement-force dataset, e.g.
`--fc-calc symfc` or `--fc-calc alm`.
entries.zh:
`--fc-calc` 选择由位移-力数据集计算力常数所用的外部求解器，例如
`--fc-calc symfc` 或 `--fc-calc alm`。

entries.name: --fc-calc-opt, --fc-calculator-options
entries.title: --fc-calc-opt, --fc-calculator-options
entries.en:
`--fc-calc-opt` passes options to the force constants calculator. For example
the cutoff pair-distance for fc3 is introduced by
    % phono3py --symfc -v --fc-calc-opt "cutoff=8"
The shortcut of `--fc-calc-opt "cutoff=8"` is `--cutoff-pair 8`.
entries.zh:
`--fc-calc-opt` 把选项传给力常数求解器。例如用配对截断距离求 fc3：
    % phono3py --symfc -v --fc-calc-opt "cutoff=8"
`--fc-calc-opt "cutoff=8"` 的简写是 `--cutoff-pair 8`。

entries.name: --cutoff-pair
entries.title: --cutoff-pair
entries.en:
`--cutoff-pair DIST` is the shortcut of `--fc-calc-opt "cutoff=DIST"`: it
limits the atom pairs used for the fc3 calculation to those within DIST,
which reduces the number of supercells, memory and computation time.
entries.zh:
`--cutoff-pair DIST` 是 `--fc-calc-opt "cutoff=DIST"` 的简写：只保留距离
DIST 以内的原子对来求 fc3，可减少所需超胞数、内存与计算时间。

entries.name: --symfc
entries.title: --symfc
entries.en:
If `phono3py_disp.yaml` is located in the current directory, force constants
are calculated from `FORCES_FC3` (and optionally `FORCES_FC2`) and
`phono3py_disp.yaml` by
    % phono3py --symfc -v
or with `phono3py_params.yaml`
    % phono3py phono3py_params.yaml --symfc -v
entries.zh:
当前目录有 phono3py_disp.yaml 时，可用 symfc 由 FORCES_FC3（可选
FORCES_FC2）加 phono3py_disp.yaml 计算力常数：
    % phono3py --symfc -v
若用 phono3py_params.yaml：
    % phono3py phono3py_params.yaml --symfc -v

entries.name: --alm
entries.title: --alm
entries.en:
ALM is another external force constants calculator that can be used instead
of symfc for displacement-force datasets (`--alm`).
entries.zh:
ALM 是另一款外部力常数求解器，可在位移-力数据集上代替 symfc 使用
（`--alm`）。

entries.name: --no-sym-fc
entries.title: --no-sym-fc
entries.en:
When force constants are calculated from a displacement and forces dataset,
force constants are automatically symmetrized. Use `--no-sym-fc` to opt out.
entries.zh:
由位移-力数据集计算力常数时，力常数会自动对称化；用 `--no-sym-fc` 可关闭
这一处理。

entries.name: --full-fc
entries.title: --full-fc
entries.en:
Compact force constants are the default since v4 (the old `--cfc` /
`--compact-fc` options were removed). `--full-fc` writes full-size force
constants instead, e.g. for codes that expect them.
entries.zh:
v4 起默认写紧凑（compact）力常数（旧的 `--cfc` / `--compact-fc` 已删除）。
`--full-fc` 改为写全尺寸力常数，供需要这种格式的程序使用。

entries.name: --mesh
entries.title: --mesh
entries.en:
`--mesh` gives the sampling mesh of the reciprocal space for the phonon and
thermal-conductivity calculation, e.g. `--mesh 11 11 11`.
    % phono3py --mesh 11 11 11 --br
entries.zh:
`--mesh` 指定声子与热导率计算的倒空间取样网格，例如 `--mesh 11 11 11`：
    % phono3py --mesh 11 11 11 --br

entries.name: --br
entries.title: --br
entries.en:
`--br` runs the lattice thermal conductivity calculation by the relaxation
time approximation (RTA).
    % phono3py --mesh 11 11 11 --br
entries.zh:
`--br` 用弛豫时间近似（RTA）计算晶格热导率：
    % phono3py --mesh 11 11 11 --br

entries.name: --lbte
entries.title: --lbte
entries.en:
`--lbte` solves the linearized phonon Boltzmann equation directly (direct
solution), which is more accurate than RTA but needs much more memory and
time.
entries.zh:
`--lbte` 直接求解线性化声子玻尔兹曼方程（direct solution），比 RTA 更准，
但内存与时间开销大得多。

entries.name: --sigma
entries.title: --sigma
entries.en:
`--thm` invokes a tetrahedron method for Brillouin zone integration for
phonon lifetime calculation, which is the default option. Instead, the
`--sigma` option can be used with the smearing widths.
entries.zh:
`--thm` 用四面体方法做布里渊区积分来算声子寿命，这是默认做法；也可以改用
`--sigma` 并给出展宽宽度。

entries.name: --isotope
entries.title: --isotope
entries.en:
`--isotope` adds phonon scattering by isotope mass disorder, using natural
abundances.
entries.zh: `--isotope` 加入同位素质量无序引起的声子散射（按天然丰度）。

entries.name: --mass-variances
entries.title: --mass-variances
entries.en:
`--mass-variances` (short: `--mv`) gives the isotope mass variance factors
explicitly, one per element, instead of using the natural abundances of
`--isotope`.
entries.zh:
`--mass-variances`（简写 `--mv`）显式给出各元素的同位素质量方差，用来代替
`--isotope` 的天然丰度值。

entries.name: --boundary-mfp
entries.title: --boundary-mfp
entries.en:
`--boundary-mfp` (short: `--bmfp`) adds boundary scattering with the given
mean free path, e.g. for a thin film or a nanostructure of finite size.
entries.zh:
`--boundary-mfp`（简写 `--bmfp`）按给定的平均自由程加入边界散射，常用于
薄膜或有限尺寸纳米结构。

entries.name: --ave-pp
entries.title: --ave-pp
entries.en:
`--ave-pp` uses the averaged phonon-phonon interaction instead of the
mode-dependent one, which is a cheaper but less accurate approximation.
entries.zh:
`--ave-pp` 用平均的声子-声子相互作用代替逐个模式的相互作用，代价小但精度
较低。

entries.name: --nu
entries.title: --nu
entries.en:
`--nu` decomposes the lattice thermal conductivity into contributions of
normal (N) and umklapp (U) processes.
entries.zh: `--nu` 把晶格热导率分解为正常过程（N）与 umklapp 过程（U）的贡献。

entries.name: --ts
entries.title: --ts
entries.en:
`--ts` gives the temperatures in K at which the properties are calculated,
e.g. `--ts 300` or `--ts 100 300 500`.
    % phono3py --br --ts 300 --mesh 19 19 19
entries.zh:
`--ts` 给出计算温度（K），例如 `--ts 300` 或 `--ts 100 300 500`：
    % phono3py --br --ts 300 --mesh 19 19 19

entries.name: --tmin, --tmax, --tstep
entries.title: --tmin, --tmax, --tstep
entries.en:
`--tmin`, `--tmax` and `--tstep` give the temperature range and step in K, as
an alternative to the discrete list of `--ts`.
entries.zh:
`--tmin`、`--tmax`、`--tstep` 用区间与步长给出温度（K），可代替 `--ts`
的离散温度列表。

entries.name: --gp
entries.title: --gp
entries.en:
`--gp` restricts the calculation to the listed irreducible grid points, whose
numbering is found in `ir_grid_points.yaml` written by `--wgp`. Phonon
lifetimes on the first ten irreducible grid points are calculated and stored
in files with the `--write-gamma` option by:
    % phono3py --mesh 11 11 11 --br --write-gamma --gp 0 1 2 3 4 5 12 13 14 15
entries.zh:
`--gp` 只计算列出的不可约网格点，其编号见 `--wgp` 写出的
ir_grid_points.yaml。配合 `--write-gamma` 可只算前十个不可约点：
    % phono3py --mesh 11 11 11 --br --write-gamma --gp 0 1 2 3 4 5 12 13 14 15

entries.name: --wgp
entries.title: --wgp
entries.en:
First run the same command with the addition option of `--wgp`:
    % phono3py --mesh 11 11 11 --br --wgp
`ir_grid_points.yaml` is obtained. Irreducible q-points are found in this
file.
entries.zh:
先加上 `--wgp` 跑一次同样的命令：
    % phono3py --mesh 11 11 11 --br --wgp
得到 ir_grid_points.yaml，其中列出不可约 q 点。

entries.name: --write-gamma
entries.title: --write-gamma
entries.en:
`--write-gamma` writes the phonon lifetime (gamma) at each `--gp` grid point
into an hdf5 file, so that the grid points can be calculated separately and
in parallel.
entries.zh:
`--write-gamma` 把各 `--gp` 网格点的声子寿命（gamma）写进 hdf5 文件，便于
把网格点拆开并行计算。

entries.name: --read-gamma
entries.title: --read-gamma
entries.en:
After finishing distributed calculations at all irreducible grid points, run
with `--read-gamma`:
    % phono3py --mesh 11 11 11 --br --read-gamma
Once this calculation runs without problem, the separately calculated hdf5
files on grid points are no more necessary and may be deleted.
entries.zh:
所有不可约网格点都算完后，用 `--read-gamma` 汇总：
    % phono3py --mesh 11 11 11 --br --read-gamma
这一步跑通后，各网格点单独生成的 hdf5 文件就不再需要，可以删除。

entries.name: --nonac
entries.title: --nonac
entries.en:
If parameters for non-analytical term correction (NAC) are found, NAC is
automatically enabled. Use `--nonac` to disable it. Since v4 the `--nac`
option was removed.
entries.zh:
只要找到非解析项修正（NAC）参数，就会自动启用 NAC；用 `--nonac` 显式关闭。
v4 起 `--nac` 选项已删除。

entries.name: --ise
entries.title: --ise
entries.en:
`--ise` calculates the imaginary part of the phonon self energy, i.e. the
phonon lifetime / linewidth, instead of the thermal conductivity.
entries.zh: `--ise` 计算声子自能的虚部，即声子寿命/线宽，而不是热导率。

entries.name: --rse
entries.title: --rse
entries.en: `--rse` calculates the real part of the phonon self energy (frequency shift).
entries.zh: `--rse` 计算声子自能的实部（频率移动）。

entries.name: --jdos
entries.title: --jdos
entries.en:
`--jdos` calculates the joint density of states (JDOS) of three phonons,
which is the harmonic part of the phonon-phonon interaction strength.
entries.zh:
`--jdos` 计算三声子联合态密度（JDOS），即声子-声子相互作用强度中只含谐波
项的部分。

entries.name: --gruneisen
entries.title: --gruneisen
entries.en: `--gruneisen` calculates the mode-Gruneisen parameters from fc3.
entries.zh: `--gruneisen` 由 fc3 计算各模式的 Gruneisen 参数。

entries.name: --config
entries.title: --config
entries.en:
`--config` reads a phono3py configuration file, where command options can be
written as setting tags instead of being given on the command line.
entries.zh: `--config` 读取 phono3py 配置文件，把命令行选项写成配置标签放在文件里。

entries.name: -o, --output-filename
entries.title: -o, --output-filename
entries.en:
`-o` takes one argument: the output yaml filename that replaces the default
`phono3py.yaml`.
entries.zh: `-o` 接受一个参数：输出 yaml 文件名，用来替换默认的 phono3py.yaml。

entries.name: FORCES_FC3
entries.title: FORCES_FC3
entries.en:
`FORCES_FC3` contains the supercell forces of the displaced supercells used
for the fc3 calculation. It is created by `phono3py-init --cf3` and read by
`phono3py` together with `phono3py_disp.yaml`.
entries.zh:
FORCES_FC3 存放求 fc3 用的各位移超胞的受力，由 `phono3py-init --cf3` 生成，
`phono3py` 会把它与 phono3py_disp.yaml 一起读取。

entries.name: FORCES_FC2
entries.title: FORCES_FC2
entries.en:
`FORCES_FC2` contains the supercell forces used for the fc2 calculation when a
larger supercell is used for fc2 than for fc3. It is created by
`phono3py-init --cf2` or `phono3py-init --fs2f2`.
entries.zh:
FORCES_FC2 存放求 fc2 用的受力（fc2 超胞比 fc3 大时使用），由
`phono3py-init --cf2` 或 `phono3py-init --fs2f2` 生成。

entries.name: FORCE_SETS
entries.title: FORCE_SETS
entries.en:
`FORCE_SETS` is the phonopy-format displacement-force dataset. phono3py can
create it with `--cfs` and convert it back to `FORCES_FC2` with `--fs2f2`.
entries.zh:
FORCE_SETS 是 phonopy 格式的位移-力数据集。phono3py 可用 `--cfs` 生成它，
再用 `--fs2f2` 把它转回 FORCES_FC2。

entries.name: phono3py_disp.yaml
entries.title: phono3py_disp.yaml
entries.en:
`phono3py_disp.yaml` is created at the displacement-generation step and is
required by `--cf3` / `--cf2` collection. `phono3py` reads it automatically
when it is in the current directory.
entries.zh:
phono3py_disp.yaml 在生成位移那一步产生，`--cf3` / `--cf2` 收集力时必须
有它；当前目录存在时 `phono3py` 会自动读取（优先级高于 phono3py.yaml）。

entries.name: phono3py_params.yaml
entries.title: phono3py_params.yaml
entries.en:
`phono3py_params.yaml` is written by `--sp` and contains all the information
required to run phono3py: crystal structure, supercell information,
displacements, forces, and parameters for non-analytical term correction. It
can be given directly to the `phono3py` command.
entries.zh:
phono3py_params.yaml 由 `--sp` 写出，包含运行 phono3py 所需的全部信息：
晶体结构、超胞信息、位移、力以及非解析项修正参数，可直接作为 `phono3py`
命令的输入。

entries.name: phono3py.yaml
entries.title: phono3py.yaml
entries.en:
`phono3py.yaml` is the default output yaml of the `phono3py` command (change
it with `-o`). Together with `phono3py_disp.yaml` it is one of the two files
`phono3py` looks for in the current directory.
entries.zh:
phono3py.yaml 是 `phono3py` 命令默认输出的 yaml（可用 `-o` 改名）。它与
phono3py_disp.yaml 是 `phono3py` 在当前目录查找的两个文件。

entries.name: fc3.hdf5 / fc2.hdf5
entries.title: fc3.hdf5 / fc2.hdf5
entries.en:
Third- and second-order force constants calculated by `phono3py` are stored in
`fc3.hdf5` and `fc2.hdf5`. When these files exist, `phono3py` reuses them
instead of recomputing the force constants from the displacement-force
dataset.
entries.zh:
`phono3py` 算出的三阶、二阶力常数分别存在 fc3.hdf5 与 fc2.hdf5。这两个文件
已存在时会直接复用，不再由位移-力数据集重新计算。

entries.name: kappa-m*.hdf5
entries.title: kappa-m*.hdf5
entries.en:
The thermal conductivity result is written to an hdf5 file whose name encodes
the mesh, e.g. `kappa-m111111.hdf5` for `--mesh 11 11 11`. It is the input of
`phono3py-kaccum` and `phono3py-kdeplot`.
entries.zh:
热导率结果写成 hdf5 文件，文件名带网格信息，例如 `--mesh 11 11 11` 得到
kappa-m111111.hdf5。它是 `phono3py-kaccum` 与 `phono3py-kdeplot` 的输入。

entries.name: kaccum.dat
entries.title: kaccum.dat
entries.en:
`kaccum.dat` is the default output file of `phono3py-kaccum`, containing the
cumulative lattice thermal conductivity as a function of mean free path.
entries.zh:
kaccum.dat 是 `phono3py-kaccum` 的默认输出，内容为累积晶格热导率随平均
自由程的变化。

entries.name: ir_grid_points.yaml
entries.title: ir_grid_points.yaml
entries.en:
`ir_grid_points.yaml` is written by `phono3py --wgp` and lists the
irreducible q-points of the mesh, whose grid point indices are used by `--gp`
for distributed calculations.
entries.zh:
ir_grid_points.yaml 由 `phono3py --wgp` 写出，列出网格中的不可约 q 点，
其编号供 `--gp` 拆分并行计算使用。

entries.name: BORN
entries.title: BORN
entries.en:
`BORN` holds the Born effective charges and dielectric tensor for the
non-analytical term correction (NAC). If NAC parameters are found,
`phono3py` enables NAC automatically; `--nonac` disables it.
entries.zh:
BORN 存放 Born 有效电荷与介电张量，用于非解析项修正（NAC）。找到 NAC 参数
时 `phono3py` 会自动启用，`--nonac` 可关闭。

entries.name: RTA
entries.title: RTA
entries.en:
The relaxation time approximation (RTA) is selected by `--br`. It is much
cheaper than the direct solution of the Boltzmann equation (`--lbte`) and is
the usual first choice for the lattice thermal conductivity.
entries.zh:
弛豫时间近似（RTA）由 `--br` 选择，开销远小于直接求解玻尔兹曼方程
（`--lbte`），是算晶格热导率的常用首选。

entries.name: tetrahedron method
entries.title: tetrahedron method
entries.en:
The tetrahedron method (`--thm`) is the default Brillouin zone integration
method for the phonon lifetime calculation; `--sigma` switches to a smearing
method with a given width.
entries.zh:
四面体方法（`--thm`）是计算声子寿命时默认的布里渊区积分方法；`--sigma`
可换成给定宽度的展宽方法。

entries.name: N and U processes
entries.title: N and U processes
entries.zh:
声子-声子散射分为正常过程（N）与 umklapp 过程（U）；`--nu` 输出两者对晶格
热导率各自的贡献。

entries.name: compact force constants
entries.title: compact force constants
entries.en:
Compact force constants are the default since phono3py v4; the old `--cfc` /
`--compact-fc` options were removed. `--full-fc` writes the full-size arrays
instead.
entries.zh:
phono3py v4 起默认使用紧凑力常数，旧的 `--cfc` / `--compact-fc` 选项已删除；
需要全尺寸数组时用 `--full-fc`。

entries.name: v3 to v4 migration
entries.title: v3 to v4 migration
entries.en:
Upgrading from phono3py v3? Version 4 introduces several breaking changes,
including a CLI split (phono3py and phono3py-init), a new default
primitive_matrix="auto", compact force constants as the default, and removal
of --nac.
entries.zh:
从 phono3py v3 升级时注意：v4 有多处不兼容改动，包括命令行拆分为
phono3py 与 phono3py-init、primitive_matrix 默认改为 "auto"、力常数默认
紧凑存储，以及删除 --nac。
